I have a complete picture. Here are my findings.

## Summary of the discrepancy (most important finding)

The **acceptance test expects an "identity-key-v2" behavior that the implementation does not yet provide.** The test (`AcceptanceTest.java`) expects:
- `identityKey` = a 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex over `normalizedTelephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName)`
- duplicate detection returning **409 Conflict** when two owners have the same identity

But the current implementation produces a **plain pipe-delimited human-readable** identity key (`telephone|email|householdId`), uses **householdId (not soundex)**, and has **no 409 duplicate rejection** anywhere in the owner-create pipeline. `soundex` does not exist in the codebase except in the test's comment. The only 409 in the whole app is `CityAtCapacityException`.

---

## 1. Identity key computation

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/OwnerIdentity.java`** — the single definition. It joins normalized telephone, email (or empty), household id (or empty) with `'|'`. Note: NOT hashed, NOT soundex.
```
18	    public static String key(String telephone, String email, String householdId) {
19	        return part(telephone) + '|' + part(email) + '|' + part(householdId);
20	    }
23	    public static String of(Owner owner) {
24	        return key(owner.getTelephone(), owner.getEmail(), owner.getHouseholdId());
25	    }
```

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — exposes `identityKey` on the response (line 41 mapping; lines 159-162):
```
160	    default String identityKey(Owner owner) {
161	        return OwnerIdentity.of(owner);
162	    }
```

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Sha256.java`** — `Sha256.upperHex(value, length)` produces the *first `length` UPPER-case* hex chars of SHA-256 (used for customerCode hash and householdId, NOT for identityKey). This is truncated + uppercase, unlike the test's full 64-char lowercase expectation.

---

## 2. Duplicate detection / 409 Conflict

There is **no hard duplicate 409 in the owner-create pipeline.** Key evidence:

- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** line 6 comment references a check that does not exist:
```
6	# before body validation and before the duplicate-household check (which would be 409).
```
The actual pipeline steps (lines 88-106) are `assignHousehold` → `assignHouseholdSize` → `assignBulkSignupWarning` → `assignPossibleDuplicate` → `assignMembershipLevelCap` → `save`. None reject/throw a duplicate 409.

- The **only** `HttpStatus.CONFLICT` (409) in the codebase is **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/CityAtCapacityExceptionHandler.java`** (lines 13-14), triggered by `RejectFullOwnerCity` — unrelated to owner duplicates.

- The `escalation/` folder has no Duplicate/Household/Conflict exception class (full list confirmed): City, Daily, DataIntegrity, DisposableEmail, Forbidden, General, FutureRegistration, InvalidEmail, InvalidPostcode, InvalidTelephone, MissingOwnerFields, NotFound, Validation.

- Note the stale javadoc reference to a non-existent class `RejectDuplicateOwnerTelephone` in **`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java`** (lines 9-10) and in `OwnerTelephones.java` line 15 — no such class exists.

---

## 3. Soft-match / possible-duplicate logic

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate.java`** — the soft-match. It does NOT reject; it just sets `possibleDuplicateOf`. Trigger conditions (lines 30-52): request is NOT `sharesHousehold`; owner has a postcode; an existing **active** owner shares last name (case-insensitive) AND postcode (normalized) but has a **different telephone**; lowest matching id wins.
```

32	            return; // a declared household member is not a suspected duplicate
34	        String lastName = canonical(owner.getLastName());
35	        String postcode = trimmed(owner.getPostcode());
36	        String telephone = trimmed(owner.getTelephone());

38	            return; // no postcode to share, so no soft match

42	            if (lastName.equals(canonical(existing.getLastName()))

```

The mapper exposes it (OwnerMapper lines 177-179): `possibleDuplicate = owner.getPossibleDuplicateOf() != null`.

---

## 4. Household / householdId logic

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerHouseholds.java`** — the shared household definition. `householdId` = first 12 UPPER-hex chars of SHA-256 over `canonicalLastName + "|" + trimmedPostcode` (lines 35-38). `members(...)` (lines 45-54) collects existing owners hashing to the same id. `canonical` collapses whitespace + lowercases (lines 57-59).

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignOwnerHousehold.java`** (lines 15-17) — stamps `owner.setHouseholdId(OwnerHouseholds.householdId(lastName, postcode))`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignOwnerHouseholdSize.java`** (lines 15-19) — sets `householdSize = 1 + members(active owners...).size()`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignOwnerMembershipLevelCap.java`** (lines 21-31) — caps new member's level to one above the highest existing household member's `membershipLevel`.

There is **no household duplicate 409 block** — despite the openapi doc (line 2098-2100 of `openapi.yml`) claiming `sharesHousehold` "allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and postcode ... which would otherwise be rejected as a duplicate." No such rejection is implemented; `sharesHousehold` only suppresses the soft-match flag in `AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate`.

---

## 5. Email-domain blocklist

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerEmails.java`** — the blocklist (lines 17-19) plus rules:
```
18	    private static final Set<String> DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS = Set.of(
19	            "mailinator.com", "tempmail.com", "guerrillamail.com");
```
`domainOf` (41-50) and `isDisposable` (53-55) decide membership.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/RejectDisposableOwnerEmail.java`** (lines 14-19) — throws `DisposableEmailDomainException` if present + disposable. Handled as **400 BAD_REQUEST** (not 409) in **`/home/daniel/.../rest/escalation/DisposableEmailDomainExceptionHandler.java`** lines 13-14.

---

## 6. Normalized telephone

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerTelephones.java`** — `toE164` (lines 45-63) strips spaces/dashes/brackets, keeps a leading `+cc` else assumes `+61` and drops one leading `0`; requires 8-15 digits and exact national length per country (`+61`→9, `+1`→10, lines 30-35, 98-111). `toDisplay` (71-80) formats for the `telephoneDisplay` field. **`NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java`** (lines 16-18) stores the E.164 value back on the request. The normalized telephone feeds `OwnerIdentity` and the soft-match comparison.

---

## 7. Shared active-owner filter

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/Owners.java`** (lines 20-28) — `active(...)` filters out soft-deleted owners; used by the namesake, household, and soft-match checks so deleted owners don't count as duplicates.

---

## 8. Tests

Only three test files exist under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test`:

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`** — the v2 duplicate/identity tests (full file, lines 9-29). Class comment (lines 9-11) states the v2 spec: `identityKey = SHA-256 hex over (normalizedTelephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName)); duplicate detection (409) uses it`.
- `coreIdentityKeyIsSha256Hex` (14-19): asserts `identityKey` matches `[0-9a-f]{64}` (64-char lowercase hex). Current impl returns e.g. `+61412345678||` → this test would FAIL.
- `coreRejectsDuplicateIdentity` (21-28): creates an owner, then a deep copy with identical telephone/email/lastName, and asserts the second POST returns `status().isConflict()` (409). Current impl has no such 409 → this test would FAIL.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`** — black-box test harness. Relevant helpers: `sha256hex` (282-294, full lowercase hex), `shaHex` (297-299, uppercase truncated), `structuredOwner()` (136-142), `uniqueEmail()` (106-108), `uniqueTelephone()` (102-104), `deleteOwner` comment (193-197) noting soft-delete makes the record ignored by "duplicate/identity checks", `createOwner`/`createOwnerOk` (155-162).

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`** — audit capture helper (not duplicate/identity related).

---

## OfficeFloor YAML files for owner creation / duplicate detection
